description: No key. Book a sponsor place for the company you act for: its name, one sentence and one link. Returns a pay_url for the person who pays (one card payment at Stripe for 30 days: a search term CHF 29.00, under a free tool CHF 49.00, the one place in front of all agents CHF 99.00). Nothing runs and nothing is owed before that payment. The text must be true, lawful and the company's own (terms 7a).

accept.description: true: the advertisement is true, lawful and belongs to the company, and terms 7a are accepted.

line.description: One sentence about the company, 10 to 140 characters, without e-mail, link or phone number.

place.description: The place, from sponsor_places (places[].place), e.g. mahnung-schreiben or agent-suche; or suche:<search words> (e.g. suche:nanny zurich) to stand in front of agents whose search holds those words and finds no listing.

url.description: The https address of the company website.

name: book_sponsor_place
